text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm out shopping...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you. Come with me if you've got
nothing
better to do. I'll give you
whatever data set you
want in return.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There're some goods I want from that
store.
Limited-edition shoes, to be
precise. The studded
U-MAX226.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
It makes no sense to me that
shop-exclusive
products still exist in this
day and age, but them's
the breaks for
me, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's a reward in it if you line up for
me. You
in?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
There's no logic in standing around in a
line. I got
mad as hell earlier when I tried
to do it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Dammit, why don't they just sell them
online to
begin with? Then I wouldn't
have to waste time
doing this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, if we're talking about a method
that suits
me, I had one from the start,
but I decided to nix
it right away.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Then again, I already got approval from
the
academy, so it'd be rude if I didn't
go ahead with
it, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Guess it's time to stop holding back and do things my way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever Air Shakur's suggesting sounds kind of unsavory, but maybe I could learn a thing or two from her way of doing things.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, can't say I didn't expect that line of
logic to
pop up. You believe in hard
work? I don't.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
But I can tell that you don't wanna do it,
even
though the opportunity to get data
from me is so
rare.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Tch, fine. I'll use the time to gather intel
on other
stores while I'm in line.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She ends up queuing up herself, tutting
and
grumbling the whole time it takes to
reach the
store. I hope the U-MAX226
shoes were worth
it...
